tech.name: Eric
tech.imageAlt: Eric, an aluminium robot with R.U.R. on its chest
tech.description: Britain's first robot, built to open the Society of Model Engineers exhibition in London. It could sit, stand and bow, and its chest read "R.U.R."

references.title: Will Wright and Steven Kaplan, eds., The Image of Technology in Literature, the Media, and Society, p. 3
Jessica Riskin, The Restless Clock (University of Chicago Press), p. 301

tech.name: Eric, rebuilt
tech.description: The original Eric disappeared after a US tour. The Science Museum rebuilt it from archive photographs, funded through Kickstarter.

references.title: Sarah Knapton, "Britain's first robot 'Eric' to rise again after lost plans found," The Telegraph
